description: This file defines an interface for management operations on grain activation within the Orleans framework, including methods for deactivation and migration when idle.

classes.name: IGrainManagementExtension
classes.description: An interface providing management operations for grain activation, such as deactivation and migration when idle.

methods.name: DeactivateOnIdle
methods.description: Deactivates the current grain instance once it becomes idle.

methods.name: MigrateOnIdle
methods.description: Attempts to migrate the current grain instance to a new location once it becomes idle.
